name: eo-toolforest
description: Workflows and gotchas for satellite imagery via Toolforest MCP: clearest-scene snapshots, NDVI/NDWI statistics, and the geo→eo→google_docs composition flow. Encodes the routing rules (never image_gen for real places), AOI handoff and simplification limits, Sentinel-2 expectations, and render-URL lifetimes — all verified in live ChatGPT eval sessions.
